prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering flow steps generated several significant wins (up to +12.0%), but carries severe downside risk (-8.9%) and frequently showed no clear effect.
Interactive flows (+6.5% to +7.2%) and interactive waiting screen features (+3.9%) were helpful and beat predictions.
UI redesigns failed to yield any wins, often caused severe performance drops (down to -19.3%), and performed worse than predicted.
Targeted copy updates were helpful for account persistence (+3.5%) and launch actions (+6.7%), though other copy changes showed no clear effect.
Hints produced no wins, either actively hurting performance (-3.1%) or showing no clear effect.
Notifications, layout changes, and standalone preview screens showed no clear effect across all rounds.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: +2.9% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, hint: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -12.5% over 3 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -3.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +2.5% over 2 test(s)
- finish, layout: -4.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: +7.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.5% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -8.6% over 2 test(s)
- home, hint: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +6.5% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: -1.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.7% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +3.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.2% over 7 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.4%

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Habitat Customizer Flow: Add an interactive habitat customization component to the companion selection screen allowing users to pick a desktop environment theme before finalizing. (why: Adoption stage has the highest drop-off with only 60.9% conversion and long median duration (89s). Interactive customization flows drive strong engagement.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Account Recovery & Sync Assurance Copy: Update sign-in screen headline and body text to clearly explain that signing in preserves pet customization and prevents account resets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again, indicating confusion around account persistence.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Companion Status Timer: Enable visual progress bars and live time estimation on the waiting screen while the pet desktop assets render. (why: Home waiting screen has an exceptionally long mean time (2336s), leading to user drop-off without visible render feedback.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Sequence Shift: Move sign-in to occur right after the adoption certificate screen is generated, leveraging high user investment. (why: Reordering sign-in after key emotional milestones can boost overall completion beyond the current 25.4% overall funnel rate.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Voice Soundboard Preview Flow: Add interactive sound trigger buttons to the pick_friend screen so users can listen to pet sound effects before picking. (why: Interactive elements boost user motivation in the adoption step, which currently has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (60.9%).)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Controls Reference Copy: Update the home intro copy with explicit desktop interaction instructions detailing shortcut keys and system tray options. (why: Multiple support emails noted post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling, hiding, or summoning the desktop pet.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Launch Tray Readiness Alert: Enable desktop notification alert on home_intro informing users that the pet icon is active in their system tray. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting that pets did not show up on the desktop or that the app appeared not to open.)

scores.note: Interactive flow directly targets the largest funnel drop-off step (adoption at 60.9%).
Direct support ticket evidence (8 emails) and low-cost sign_in copy update with proven history.
Addresses severe home step wait times (2336s mean) using proven waiting screen features.
Reordering flow steps has high downside risk and historical sign_in reorders show modest wins.
Interactive preview soundboard targets the lowest conversion step with high success confidence.
Easy copy fix addressing post-onboarding confusion backed by support emails.
Notifications consistently fail to deliver wins and often show slight negative impact.
